title: Meridian Logistics Corp — Master Services & Licensing Agreement
summary: Confidential enterprise MSA between Northbridge Holdings Group and Meridian Logistics Corp covering annual contract value, SLA guarantees, and dispute resolution.
content:
CONFIDENTIAL LEGAL RECORD — MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

Counterparty: Meridian Logistics Corp (Synthetic)
Contract Reference: NBH-MSA-2026-041
Effective Date: August 4, 2026 | Term: 36 Months

1. Commercial Terms
Annual Contract Value (ACV): $4,800,000 billed quarterly in advance.

2. Service Level Agreement
Northbridge commits to 99.95% monthly uptime. SLA service credits are capped at 10% of the impacted monthly fee.

3. Governing Law & Non-Disclosure
Governed by the laws of the State of Delaware. Neither party may disclose pricing schedules or security architecture terms to unauthorized personnel.
